Enrollment Condition
data.description: Definition of an enrolled participant
data.text: "Enrolled" means all participants who sign the informed consent form (ICF), are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day -7 when participants are assigned a participant number.

data.name: Treatment History Eligibility
data.description: Both treatment-experienced and treatment-naive participants are eligible
data.text: Treatment-experienced (which includes standard of care therapies or ALXN1840) and treatment-naïve participants are eligible for this study.

data.name: Zinc Washout Condition
data.description: Participants must be off zinc therapy before first dose to avoid confounding copper balance
data.text: Participants must be off zinc therapy for a minimum of 21 days prior to Day 1; inhibitory effect of zinc on intestinal copper absorption is expected to be minimal 21 days after discontinuation of zinc. Previous treatment with zinc within 21 days prior to Day 1 is exclusionary.

data.name: Chelator Discontinuation Condition
data.description: Chelator therapy discontinued to establish pretreatment copper baseline
data.text: To assess the copper baseline during the Inpatient Run-in Period, participants will be discontinued from their chelator therapy for approximately 4 days prior to initiating ALXN1840, while maintained on a copper-controlled diet.

data.name: SRC Safety Review Before Titration
data.description: Safety Review Committee review required prior to dose escalation
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Safety Concern Precluding Dose Escalation
data.description: Participants may remain at 15 mg/day if escalation poses undue risk
data.text: Dosing will be initiated at 15 mg once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks, with an increase to 30 mg after 4 weeks, unless there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk, in which case participants may remain on the 15 mg/day dose for the duration of the study.

data.name: Neutrophil Decline Dose Modification Condition
data.description: Hematologic dose modification trigger
data.text: Neutrophils decreased > 30% from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Hepatic Injury Dose Modification Condition
data.description: Liver injury dose modification trigger
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption of ALXN1840 with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening Condition
data.description: Evidence of neurologic worsening triggers dose evaluation
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or by neurologic physical exam assessment: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale documented and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening Condition
data.description: Clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening triggers dose evaluation
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening which may include but is not limited to suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease).

data.name: Rechallenge Conditions
data.description: Limits and conditions for rechallenge after dose interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. Rechallenge after bilirubin elevation may occur at 15 mg QOD or less frequent dosing when bilirubin is below ULN and requires approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor. Participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. The Investigator, in consultation with the Medical Monitor, may change dose and dose frequency in participants who require rechallenge.

data.name: Adaptive Design Features
data.description: Protocol incorporates adaptive features at Investigator discretion
data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol. Adaptive features and their limits are described in Table 4.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Condition
data.description: Conditional extension of the Outpatient Period
data.text: To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. In this situation, participants will be given additional investigational product to support daily dosing throughout the Outpatient Period; the actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Continued Inpatient Stay Condition
data.description: Participants may remain in the CRU rather than be discharged on Day 9
data.text: Participants will be admitted to the CRU for Treatment Period 1 on Day -8 and may be discharged on Day 9 or remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study (at the CRU's discretion).

data.name: Clinically Significant ECG Finding Condition
data.description: Assessment of continued participation after clinically significant findings
data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to changes from baseline in QTcF) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed.

data.name: Childbearing Potential Enrollment Condition
data.description: Pregnancy test requirement prior to enrollment
data.text: Women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening.

data.name: Dietary Compliance Condition
data.description: Willingness to complete controlled diet
data.text: Participants unwilling to consistently complete every meal and tolerate a controlled, limited menu for the duration of the study are excluded; participants will be strongly encouraged to complete all meals during inpatient periods.

data.name: Drug/Alcohol Screen Condition
data.description: Negative drug and alcohol screening required at Screening and Day -8
data.text: Positive urine drug toxicology screen at Screening or on Day -8 (cannabinoids not tested), or positive alcohol breath test at Screening or on Day -8, is exclusionary.

data.name: US Screening-Only Site Condition
data.description: US sites may perform screening procedures only
data.text: Text applicable only to the US details the possibility for sites in the US to only perform screening procedures and not any of the remaining study procedures, to facilitate participant recruitment across different regions of the US.

data.name: Screening to Run-in/Enrollment Transition
data.text: Participants who sign the ICF and are eligible for the study are registered and enrolled on Day -7 and assigned a participant number; a copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet is initiated after registration/inclusion. Participants are admitted to the CRU on Day -8.

data.name: Run-in to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following the Run-in Period (diet equilibration Day -7 to Day -5 and baseline copper/molybdenum balance Day -4 to Day -1), participants are administered ALXN1840 15 mg/day starting on Day 1; participants must be off zinc ≥ 21 days and off chelator approximately 4 days prior.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from the CRU on Day 9 to the Outpatient Period, during which SMS text messaging is used to confirm study intervention administration; alternatively participants may remain in the CRU for safety or study integrity.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient Period 2 Transition
data.text: Participants are re-admitted on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose) for Treatment Period 2; all procedures start on Day 23 and participants remain in house until Day 40. If the Outpatient Period is extended up to 14 additional days, the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Escalation from 15 mg/day to 30 mg/day
data.text: After a minimum of approximately 4 weeks of 15 mg/day dosing (Day 1 through Day 28) and SRC review of available safety data through Day 23 for each participant, the dose is increased to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39, unless safety concerns preclude escalation.

data.name: Dose Reduction for Neutrophil Decline
data.text: Neutrophils > 30% decreased from baseline with baseline neutrophils below reference range: reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred, or reduce to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD; no further dose increase until resolution of abnormality, with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Temporary Dose Interruption for Hepatic Injury
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN indicative of liver injury requires temporary interruption of ALXN1840, with weekly repeat testing; rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN and with Alexion Medical Monitor approval.

data.name: Dose Modification for Neurologic or Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: For neurologic worsening or clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening, the Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale documented and re-evaluated at next study visit.

data.name: Rechallenge After Dose Interruption
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. Participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. The Investigator, in consultation with the Medical Monitor, may change dose and dose frequency in participants who require rechallenge.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Safety Events
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if any of the following occur: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or the Investigator deems it necessary for the participant.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Abnormal Liver Function
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention for abnormal liver function should be considered by the Investigator when a participant meets one of the conditions outlined in the Dose Modification criteria (Section 6.6) or if the Investigator believes it is in the best interest of the participant.

data.name: Continuation in Study After Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow-up, with data collected per the SoA at the time of discontinuation and follow-up.

data.name: Participant Withdrawal From Study
data.text: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons; the participant will be permanently discontinued both from the study intervention and from the study at that time.

data.name: Post-Study Therapy Transition
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods (ie, Day 40), participants will either transition to therapy that was discontinued before enrollment, transition to other standard of care therapy as directed by the treating physician, or, at the discretion of the treating physician, request continuation of ALXN1840 treatment permissible under local regulations for preapproval access.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the Schedule of Activities. All participants should return to the CRU for the EOS Visit on Day 54 (+/- 2 days). The end of the study is defined as the date the last participant completes the last visit shown in the SoA.

data.name: Early Termination / Early Discontinuation Visit
data.description: At the time of discontinuation from the study, if possible, an early discontinuation visit (End of Study/Early Termination Visit, including full physical examination) should be conducted as shown in the SoA; the participant is permanently discontinued from both study intervention and the study.

data.name: Withdrawal of Consent
data.description: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request. If the participant withdraws consent for disclosure of future information, Alexion may retain and continue to use any data collected before such withdrawal; the participant may request destruction of any samples taken and not tested.

data.name: Investigator/Sponsor-Initiated Withdrawal
data.description: A participant may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons, or if Alexion or the Investigator deems it necessary for the participant.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: A participant will be considered lost to follow-up if he or she repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site. Before a participant is deemed lost to follow-up, the Investigator or designee must make every effort to regain contact (where possible, 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter to the last known mailing address). Should the participant continue to be unreachable, he/she will be considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Study or Site Termination by Sponsor
data.description: Alexion reserves the right to close the study site or terminate the study at any time for any reason. Reasons for early closure may include failure of the Investigator to comply with the protocol, IRB/IEC or local health authority requirements, Alexion's procedures or GCP guidelines; inadequate recruitment of participants; or discontinuation of further study intervention development. If prematurely terminated, the Investigator shall promptly inform the participant and assure appropriate participant therapy and/or follow-up.

data.name: Pregnancy
data.description: Pregnancy or planned pregnancy requires consideration for discontinuation from study intervention.

data.name: Protocol Deviation - Use of Disallowed Medication
data.description: Use of disallowed medication (prescription medications within 14 days or 5 half-lives, nonprescription drugs including vitamins/supplements within 7 days or 5 half-lives before Day -7 and until completion of the follow-up visit, except as allowed) requires consideration for discontinuation from study intervention.

data.name: Eligibility/Enrollment Decision at Day -7
data.description: Participants who sign the ICF and meet all eligibility criteria (including zinc washout ≥ 21 days and negative drug/alcohol/pregnancy screens) are registered and enrolled on Day -7 and initiated on the copper/molybdenum-controlled diet.

data.name: Day 9 Discharge Decision
data.description: Decision at Day 9 whether the participant is discharged to the Outpatient Period (returning Day 22 or 23) or remains in the CRU for safety or study integrity; the Outpatient Period may be extended up to 14 additional days with Investigator approval.

data.name: SRC Titration Decision Before Day 29
data.description: Before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29, the SRC reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant; participants may remain at 15 mg/day if safety concerns place them at undue risk.

data.name: Dose Modification Decision Based on Safety Laboratory Results
data.description: Assessment of hematology and liver function parameters (Days -8, -1, 8, 23, 28 and weekly repeat testing) triggers dose reduction, interruption, restriction of dose increase, or rechallenge decisions.

data.name: Neurologic/Psychiatric Assessment Decision
data.description: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor decide on dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and clinical data; rationale re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Post-Study Treatment Decision at Day 40
data.description: Following completion of both inpatient periods (Day 40), decision to resume prior therapy, start other standard of care, or request continued ALXN1840 under preapproval access.

data.name: Clinically Significant Finding Continuation Decision
data.description: Following identification of a clinically significant finding (eg, QTcF change from baseline) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee determines whether the participant can continue in the study.
